title: Known-truth causal-slice observation-object competition
question: Is the Phase1250 response advantage specific to a distributed event bundle, or is an explicit condition or one late answer state already sufficient?

hypothesis_predictions.observable: Group-bootstrap code-response cosine for a fixed full trajectory against the selection-chosen best late single state and ex-ante condition object.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: The full bundle beats every late single state by at least 0.05 with a positive group-bootstrap lower bound in at least four of six networks and every depth.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: A late single state or ex-ante object is non-inferior in at least four networks and every depth, or the full trajectory fails to reproduce.

hypothesis_predictions.observable: Equal 80-dimensional source, condition, late-single, no-boundary, full, and leave-one-out cameras on sealed groups.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: An output-adjacent single state can match the full trajectory if Phase1250 mainly imaged a downstream consequence.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: The full and no-boundary distributed objects both show preregistered advantages across depth while late single and ex-ante objects fail.

data_contract.cluster_unit: One two-code world crossed with four later shifts and direct/code representations.
data_contract.split_rule: All shifts and representations from a world remain indivisible; confirmation never selects event, family, ridge, or threshold.
data_contract.answer_payload_rule: Direct exposes the label at source; code exposes a code whose label is defined by the later table.

metrics.estimator: Held-out cosine, relative error, and positive fraction.
Group-bootstrap cosine difference between registered observation objects.
Target-minus-null norm and null divided by target.

typed_gates.rule: At least four of six models and every depth pass direct and code behavior.
The full camera reproduces direct and code response in at least four models and every depth.
The selected late single state reaches code cosine 0.90 and is non-inferior within 0.03 in at least four models and every depth.
The selected ex-ante object reaches code cosine 0.90 and is non-inferior within 0.03 in at least four models and every depth.
Full and no-boundary bundles each beat matched best single states by 0.05 with positive bootstrap lower bounds in breadth.

budget.right_censoring_rule: No replacement seeds, event additions, threshold relaxation, or confirmation reselection.

stopping_rules: A late-single pass rejects multi-event observational necessity.
A camera-input deletion is not physical necessity.
No pretrained model follows this phase automatically.
Failure cannot be repaired with extra seeds or events.

adjudication.failure_claim: All six selection procedures chose the final answer-boundary state; its code cosine 0.9976-0.9991 exceeded the full five-event camera, so multiple measured events were not observationally necessary.
adjudication.reopen_condition: A new causal contract must physically block and rescue state carriers; it may not restore the distributed observational claim.
